llm.summary: This skill is a coherent brand-narrative registry that uses disclosed, permissioned local persistence and shows no malware or prompt-injection indicators.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to record and query versioned brand narrative canon, and the described reads and writes are directly tied to that registry workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require user authorization before writes, current-revision checks, complete canon updates, untrusted treatment of drafts, and bounded handoff if the required host runtime is unavailable.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only a markdown skill file and no executable scripts; it references repository-level runtime and reference files outside the package, so standalone installs may be read-only or incomplete.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Access is scoped to local narrative memory/projection files and related claim/proof pointers for the user’s brand work; no network, credential, package-install, or unrelated data access is requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is designed to persist append-only narrative events and regenerate views, but that persistence is disclosed, versioned, reversible by history, and gated through explicit permission and host capability.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a persistent local registry for brand narrative canon. Before relying on write features, confirm the expected registry runtime and referenced protocol files exist in your host environment, and review proposed canon updates because the skill is meant to create durable version-history records.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, which matches the artifact’s disclosed, purpose-aligned behavior.
[Static scan clean result] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns; the inspected artifact contains no executable code or hidden install behavior.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: VirusTotal reported zero malicious or suspicious detections; this is supporting telemetry, not the sole basis for the verdict.
